name: agent_key
description: Stable key: Agent Runtime / Gemini Enterprise / Agent Registry resource name, or 'oauth:<client_id>' / 'dwd:<client_id>' for Workspace apps

name: source
description: AgentRuntime | GeminiEnterprise | AgentRegistry | CloudAsset | WorkspaceOAuth | WorkspaceDWD | Manual

name: oauth_client_id
description: Workspace OAuth client ID, if any

name: effective_identity
description: ReasoningEngine spec.effectiveIdentity (service agent, service account or agents.global principal)

name: service_account
description: Service account the agent runs as, if any

name: service_account_unique_id
description: Numeric unique ID of that service account (audit resourceName can carry this instead of the email)

name: user_accounts_and_credentials
description: User accounts, delegated users, keys or auth providers the agent uses (ISM-2135)

name: permissions
description: IAM roles and OAuth scopes granted

name: declared_tools
description: Tools the agent can call (classMethods, enabledTools, Agent Registry skills)

name: mcp_servers
description: MCP servers the agent uses (Agent Registry)

name: shared_with
description: Sharing scope (Gemini Enterprise sharingConfig, OAuth users)

name: lifecycle_status
description: State from source (e.g. Gemini Enterprise agent state)

name: decision_by
description: Identity of the human who decided (ISM-2113)

name: case_ref
description: SecOps case ID or workflow execution ID
